title: For every guest who joins a 2025 Lake Eyre tour, APT will donate $100 to Rural Aid’s Queensland flood appeal - with a matching contribution from the APT Foundation
author: Alice
body:
20 June 2025

For nearly a century, APT has been helping guests discover the world through our unforgettable tours and cruises. As a proudly Australian, family-owned company, we care deeply about giving back to the communities we’re part of—especially those in our own backyard. That’s why, in response to the recent Queensland floods, we’re supporting those affected in a meaningful way.

For every guest who joins one of our Lake Eyre tours in 2025, we will donate $100 to Rural Aid for our Queensland flood appeal. Our charitable fund, the APT Foundation, will match this contribution, doubling the amount donated.

Join one of our wonderful journeys featuring Lake Eyre, the Flinders Ranges and the Painted Hills. View tours here: https://www.aptouring.com/en-au/search?global%5Bquery%5D=lake%20eyre
